anchor.name: KBIC
anchor.address: Kobe Biomedical Innovation Cluster, Port Island, Kobe

cohorts.name: Cohort 3
cohorts.end_date_note: not fixed: Haus pages show slightly different end dates; edit when confirmed
cohorts.target_residents_note: planning estimate, 40 to 50 people per Aug 20 call
cohorts.notes: Arrival Sept 15 (orientation Sept 17 to 18). Fitzgerald floors start Sept 27, so Sept 15 to 27 is a bridge window. Alum house opens Sept 1.

haus_nodes.name: Punkhaus
haus_nodes.description: The fundraising flagship. Cohort housing, communal kitchen, dry-lab workspace, and the weekly dinners where companies go from angel to seed.
haus_nodes.planning_note: Aug 20 planning call: the cohort residence is expected to be the Fitzgerald (620 Post St) from Sept 27, two floors, whole building as next year's aim. That deal was 'being signed' on Aug 20; our data does not confirm a signature.
haus_nodes.source: haus.fund/punkhaus (Sept 2026); Ria and Elliot planning call Aug 20 2026

haus_nodes.name: Femhaus
haus_nodes.description: The all-women house. A founder residence blending rigorous scientific work, startup building, and a culture of mutual care and ambition.
haus_nodes.planning_note: Aug 20 planning call: 2550 Van Ness (with Minerva University) is being worked for Femhaus or Safehaus; about 10 to 12 women, kitchen required.

haus_nodes.name: Alumhaus
haus_nodes.description: The alumni house. Where graduated founders keep building inside the network: extended stays, ongoing community, and the gravitational center of the alumni layer.
haus_nodes.planning_note: Aug 20 planning call: alum house operational Sept 1 2026.

haus_nodes.name: Safehaus
haus_nodes.description: The biosecurity house. A live-in residency for founders building defenses against engineered pandemics: countermeasures, DNA-synthesis screening, and biosurveillance.
haus_nodes.planning_note: 2550 Van Ness is a candidate for either Femhaus or Safehaus (Aug 20 call).

haus_nodes.name: Cellhaus
haus_nodes.description: Lab space inside KBIC, the Kobe Biomedical Innovation Cluster, with cohort living space on campus. Bench and bed on the same island. First cohort targeted September 2026 with Frontier Humans, running into Mirai Tech PopUp City on Port Island.

haus_nodes.name: Pharmhaus
haus_nodes.description: With BioLeap (operated by parallel18), residents get lab space at the Confluence Center in Science City plus cGMP pilot plant access. Cohort housing anchored at Casa Chironja, a beachside coliving compound in San Juan.

haus_nodes.name: Greenhaus
haus_nodes.description: With Crecimiento, lab and coworking space at +54 Lab inside the Parque de Innovacion, Buenos Aires' science and technology district.
